    'README.md': '# Blackjack Project v.01\n\nBased on the supplied BlackjackOverlay-v0.9-FINAL-source.txt.\nApp label: Blackjack Project v.01. Version name: v.01. Android version code: 10.\nPackage and included development signing key retained for update compatibility.\n\n## Review changes\n\n- Removed automatic background learning and automatic scanner start. No detected\n  card groups did not prove that the table was empty: ambiguous, rejected, small,\n  or obscured cards could all produce zero groups. Learning such a frame could\n  suppress real cards from later recognition. Calibration UI could also trigger it.\n- Background learning is now explicitly requested through Learn empty. Scan start\n  checks the reference on the recognition worker and ignores requests invalidated\n  by Stop, calibration, or shutdown.\n- Stopped overlay displays the calibration diagnostic instead of hiding it.\n- Retained the supplied removal of the OCR confidence gate; no threshold restored.\n- Updated the launcher, main screen, overlay, notification and diagnostics branding.\n- Build workflow now requires passing regression tests; output is named\n  Blackjack-Project-v.01.apk.\n\n## Current validation\n\nAll nine existing pure-Java regression suites passed on October 6, 2026.\nAndroid assembly/lint could not run: Gradle 8.9 download failed with Network is\nunreachable, and no Android SDK is installed in this execution environment.\nNo v.01 APK was produced. Android UI changes are not compilation-verified here.\nRecognition accuracy on real video or a phone has NOT been validated.\nHistorical validation documents describe earlier versions only.\n\n## Build the APK\n\nWith JDK 17, Android SDK 35 and network access:\n\n    bash tests/run.sh\n    bash gradlew assembleDebug lintDebug\n\nResult: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk.\nRename that file Blackjack-Project-v.01.apk.\nAlternatively upload this project to your own GitHub repository, including the\n.github directory, and run the included Build Blackjack Project v.01 workflow.\nDownload the Blackjack-Project-v.01 artifact from its successful run and extract\nits APK. The workflow has been supplied but was not run in this session.\n\nThe included development signing key is public test material, not a production key.\n\n## Use\n\n1. Start observation and allow overlay and full-display capture.\n2. Open the table and place the overlay outside the card area.\n3. Open Calibrate while the physical card area is empty and hands are clear.\n4. Configure one table region and the dealer/seven player anchors and angles.\n5. Tap Learn empty, Save calibration, then Start.\n6. Confirm the overlay says RUNNING; inspect its region/OCR/stable-card diagnostics.\n7. Use the built-in recorder and export logs for actual device validation.\n\nRepeat empty-reference calibration when capture restarts or the table layout changes.\nThis remains an experimental observer. It does not place bets, and missed/overlapping\ncards can make counts incomplete. A moving count is not proof of an accurate count.\n'.encode("utf-8"),

"+selected+" anchor · left to right":"Round status";}\n    private RectF target(){if(selected<0)return new RectF(regions.table);if(selected==8)return new RectF(regions.boxes[8]);float[]            p.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);c.drawBitmap(picture,null,imageRect,p);\n            p.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);p.setStrokeWidth(2);p.setColor(selected<0?Color.YELLOW:0xff78ebbb);c.drawRect(map(regions.table),p);\n            p.setColor(selected==8?Color.YELLOW:0xff78ebbb);c.drawRect(map(absolute(regions.boxes[8])),p);\n            if(result!=null){p.setColor(Color.CYAN);for(RectF     'app/src/main/java/com/example/blackjackoverlay/CardIdentity.java': 'package com.example.blackjackoverlay;\nimport java.util.*;\n\n/** Persistent rank-corner identities between confirmed table clears. */\npublic final class CardIdentity {\n private static final class Track {float x,y;int seat,streak,lastFrame;String candidate,rank;}\n private final List<Track> tracks=new ArrayList<>();private int frame;\n public boolean conflict;\n public void clear(){tracks.clear();frame=0;conflict=false;}\n public List<List<String>> observe(List<HandGrouping.Read> reads,int width){\n  frame++;conflict=false;Set<Track> used=new HashSet<>();Set<Integer> consumed=new HashSet<>();\n  // Closest pairs first keeps neighboring identical-rank cards distinct.\n  while(true){Track best=null;int index=-1;double distance=width*.023;\n   for(int i=0;i<reads.size();i++)if(!consumed.contains(i)){HandGrouping.Read r=reads.get(i);\n    for(Track t:tracks)if(!used.contains(t)&&(r.window==0)==(t.seat==0)){\n     double d=Math.hypot(r.x-t.x,r.y-t.y);if(d<distance){distance=d;best=t;index=i;}\n    }\n   }\n   if(best==null)break;update(best,reads.get(index));used.add(best);consumed.add(index);\n  }\n  for(int i=0;i<reads.size();i++)if(!consumed.contains(i)){\n   HandGrouping.Read r=reads.get(i);Track t=new Track();t.seat=r.window;t.candidate=r.rank;t.x=r.x;t.y=r.y;tracks.add(t);update(t,r);\n  }\n  tracks.removeIf(t->t.rank==null&&frame-t.lastFrame>4);\n  List<List<String>> result=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<8;i++)result.add(new ArrayList<>());\n  for(Track t:tracks)if(t.rank!=null)result.get(t.seat).add(t.rank);return result;\n }\n private void update(Track t,HandGrouping.Read r){\n  if(t.rank!=null&&!t.rank.equals(r.rank)){conflict=true;t.lastFrame=frame;return;}\n  if(t.candidate.equals(r.rank)&&t.lastFrame==frame-1)t.streak++;else{t.candidate=r.rank;t.streak=1;}\n  t.x=r.x;t.y=r.y;t.lastFrame=frame;if(t.streak>=3)t.rank=t.candidate;\n }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'app/src/main/java/com/example/blackjackoverlay/CardLayout.java': 'package com.example.blackjackoverlay;\n/** Five adjustable rank-corner windows for each of seven screen-ordered seats. */\npublic final class CardLayout {\n    public final float[][][] slots=new float[7][5][5]; // center x/y, width/height, OCR rotation\n    public CardLayout(){\n        float[] x={171,260,373,465,576,678,789},y={788,811,833,833,826,814,788};\n        float[] dx={37,33,25,21,16,-15,-24},dy={-14,-18,-19,-20,-22,-20,-21},a={-25,-17,-7,0,10,22,34};\n        for(int h=0;h<7;h++)for(int k=0;k<5;k++)slots[h][k]=new float[]{(x[h]+k*dx[h])/945f,(y[h]+k*dy[h])/2048f,48/945f,24/2048f,a[h]};\n    }\n    public CardLayout copy(){CardLayout c=new CardLayout();for(int h=0;h<7;h++)for(int k=0;k<5;k++)c.slots[h][k]=slots[h][k].clone();return c;}\n    public float[] bounds(int h){float l=1,t=1,r=0,b=0;for(float[] s:slots[h]){l=Math.min(l,s[0]-s[2]/2);t=Math.min(t,s[1]-s[3]/2);r=Math.max(r,s[0]+s[2]/2);b=Math.max(b,s[1]+s[3]/2);}return new float[]{l,t,r,b};}\n    public void transformHand(int h,float l,float t,float r,float b){float[] old=bounds(h);float xs=(r-l)/(old[2]-old[0]),ys=(b-t)/(old[3]-old[1]);for(float[] s:slots[h]){s[0]=l+(s[0]-old[0])*xs;s[1]=t+(s[1]-old[1])*ys;s[2]*=xs;s[3]*=ys;}}\n    public float[] corners(int h,int k,float width,float height){float[] s=slots[h][k];float cx=s[0]*width,cy=s[1]*height,hw=s[2]*width/2,hh=s[3]*height/2;double a=Math.toRadians(-s[4]);float[] q={-hw,-hh,hw,-hh,hw,hh,-hw,hh};for(int n=0;n<8;n+=2){float x=q[n],y=q[n+1];q[n]=cx+(float)(x*Math.cos(a)-y*Math.sin(a));q[n+1]=cy+(float)(x*Math.sin(a)+y*Math.cos(a));}return q;}\n    public void rotate(int h,int k,float degrees,float aspect){if(k>=0){slots[h][k][4]+=degrees;return;}float[] b=bounds(h);float cx=(b[0]+b[2])/2,cy=(b[1]+b[3])/2;double a=Math.toRadians(-degrees);for(float[] s:slots[h]){float x=s[0]-cx,y=(s[1]-cy)/aspect;s[0]=cx+(float)(x*Math.cos(a)-y*Math.sin(a));s[1]=cy+aspect*(float)(x*Math.sin(a)+y*Math.cos(a));s[4]+=degrees;}}\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),

in=codec.getInputImage(idx);if(in==null)throw new IOException("Encoder has no YUV input image");\n            Image.Plane[] planes=in.getPlanes();int[] pixels=new c=pixels[py*width+px],r=(c>>16)&255,g=(c>>8)&255,b=c&255;\n                put(planes[0],px,py,clamp(((66*r+129*g+25*b+128)>>8)+16));\n codec.queueInputBuffer(idx,0,width*height*3/2,(now-start)*1000,0);\n        }\n        drain(false);\n    }\n    private int clamp(int n){return Math.max(0,Math.min(255,n));}\n    private void put(Image.Plane p,int x,int y,int value){p.getBuffer().put(y*p.getRowStride()+x*p.getPixelStride(),(byte)value);}\n    private void drain(boolean end){\n        MediaCodec.BufferInfo info=new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();int tries=0;\n        while(true){int n=codec.dequeueOutputBuffer(info,end?10000:0);\n            if(n==MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER){if(!end||++tries>50)break;continue;}\n            if(n==MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED){track=muxer.addTrack(codec.getOutputFormat());muxer.start();muxStarted=true;continue;}\n            if(n>=0){ByteBuffer b=codec.getOutputBuffer(n);if((info.flags&MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG)!=0)info.size=0;\n                if(info.size>0&&muxStarted){b.position(info.offset);b.limit(info.offset+info.size);muxer.writeSampleData(track,b,info);}\n                codec.releaseOutputBuffer(n,false);if((info.flags&MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM)!=0)break;}\n        }\n    }\n    public void close(){\n        try{int n=codec.dequeueInputBuffer(100000);if(n>=0){codec.queueInputBuffer(n,0,0,Math.max(0,android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()-start)*1000,MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);drain(true);}}catch(Exception ignored){}\n        try{codec.stop();}catch(Exception ignored){}codec.release();\n        try{if(muxStarted)muxer.stop();}catch(Exception ignored){}muxer.release();frame.recycle();\n s : null;\n    }\n    public static int value(String rank) {\n        if (rank.matches("[2-6]")) return 1;\n        return rank.matches("[7-9]") ? 0 : -1;\n    }\n    /** Called once per successful OCR sampling cycle, including null readings. */\n    public boolean observe(int id, String raw) {\n        Slot s=slots.computeIfAbsent(id, k -> new Slot());\n        if(s.accepted != null || s.suppressed) return false;\n        String rank=parseRank(raw);\n        if(rank==null) { s.candidate=null; s.streak=0; return false; }\n        if(rank.equals(s.candidate)) s.streak++; else { s.candidate=rank; s.streak=1; }\n        if(s.streak<3) return false;\n        s.accepted=rank; running+=value(rank); cards++;\n        history.push(new Event(id,rank,hand)); return true;\n    }\n    public String accepted(int id) { Slot s=slots.get(id); return s==null?null:s.accepted; }\n    public void breakCandidates() { for(Slot s:slots.values()){s.candidate=null;s.streak=0;} }\n    public void nextHand() { slots.clear(); hand++; }\n    public void resetShoe() { slots.clear(); history.clear(); running=0; cards=0; hand++; }\n    public boolean undo() {\n        if(history.isEmpty()) return false;\n        Event e=history.pop(); running-=value(e.rank); cards--;\n        if(e.hand==hand) {\n            Slot s=slots.get(e.slot);\n            if(s!=null) {s.accepted=null;s.suppressed=true;}\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n    public int running() { return running; }\n    public int cards() { return cards; }\n    public String last() { return history.isEmpty()?"—":history.peek().rank; }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),

boolean duplicate=false;for(Detection p:reads)if(Math.hypot(p.x-d.x,p.y-d.y)<width*.010){duplicate=true;if(!p.rank.equals(d.rank)){out.unsafeSeats.add(d.seat);out.unsafeSeats.add(p.seat);}}\n   if(!duplicate)reads.add(d);\n  }\n  Set<Track> used=new HashSet<>();Set<Integer> consumed=new HashSet<>();\n  // Global nearest-neighbour matching; never transfer a confirmed card between seats.\n  while(true){Track best=null;int index=-1;double distance=width*.024;\n   for(int i=0;i<reads.size();i++)if(!consumed.contains(i))for(Track t:tracks)if(!used.contains(t)){\n    Detection d=reads.get(i);double dd=Math.hypot(t.x-d.x,t.y-d.y);\n    if(dd<distance){distance=dd;best=t;index=i;}\n   }\n   if(best==null)break;Detection d=reads.get(index);used.add(best);consumed.add(index);\n   if(best.seat!=d.seat||(best.rank!=null&&!best.rank.equals(d.rank))){out.unsafeSeats.add(best.seat);out.unsafeSeats.add(d.seat);best.last=frame;continue;}\n   update(best,d);\n  }\n  Set<Integer> missing=new HashSet<>();for(Track t:tracks)if(t.rank!=null&&!used.contains(t))missing.add(t.seat);\n  out.unsafeSeats.addAll(missing);\n  for(int i=0;i<reads.size();i++)if(!consumed.contains(i)){\n consecutive and suppressed for ambiguous seats.\n  for(Track t:tracks)if(t.last==frame&&t.rank==null&&t.streak>=3&&!out.unsafeSeats.contains(t.seat))t.rank=t.candidate;\n  tracks.removeIf(t->t.rank==null&&frame-t.last>3);\n  StringBuilder log=new StringBuilder();\n  for(Track t:tracks){\n   if(t.rank!=null){out.counted.get(t.seat).add(t.rank);log.append(t.id).append(\':\').append(t.seat).append(\':\').append(t.rank).append(\'@\').append(Math.round(t.x)).append(\',\').append(Math.round(t.y)).append(\';\');}\n expected=reads.stream().filter(p->p.seat==d.seat).count();if(total!=expected)out.unsafeSeats.add(d.seat);\n  }\n  if(out.uncertain)out.reason="Moved, hidden or conflicting cards at seats "+out.unsafeSeats;\n  out.tracks=log.toString();return out;\n }\n private void update(Track t,Detection d){\n  t.streak=d.rank.equals(t.candidate)&&t.last==frame-1?t.streak+1:1;\n     'docs/README-v0.9-historical.md': '# Blackjack Observer v0.9 — repair test build\n\nThis Android app observes screen cards and displays a provisional Hi-Lo count\nand advice for one selected seat. This is an experimental test build. It has\nNOT passed automatic-recognition acceptance; read VALIDATION.md.\n\n## Install\n\nInstall BlackjackObserver-test-v0.9.apk as an update. Same package and development\nsigning key as v0.8; version code 9, minimum Android 8/API 26.\n\n## Start\n\n1. Start observation and allow the overlay and full-screen capture.\n2. Open the table. Keep orientation and browser zoom fixed. Place the overlay\n   outside the physical-card area.\n3. Wait until all cards and hands are clear of that area. Open Calibrate, which\n   freezes the screen. Use one table rectangle covering physical dealer/player\n   cards, excluding chips, shoes, digital duplicates and neighboring tables.\n4. Put the dealer and seven player anchors at first-card positions. Seats stay\n   numbered 1–7 left to right, including empty seats. Angle controls describe\n   clockwise card tilt. Tap Learn empty, Save calibration, then Start.\n5. Green RUNNING means scanning is enabled; red STOPPED means scanning is off.\n   Seat selects advice only. All recognized seats contribute to the count.\n6. Learn a fresh empty reference at every capture session or layout/camera change.\n   Use Test frame to inspect reads; the preview itself never changes the count.\n7. Record a deal-to-clear cycle with the built-in recorder. Export its MP4 and\n   diagnostics from the main app. Running another screen recorder can stop capture.\n\n## Repairs in this build\n\n- Confirmed cards count before a complete round or readable dealer is available.\n- Starting a round retains previously accepted cards instead of recounting them.\n- Empty-table and shoe transitions discard stale visual identities before they\n  can be added back into a reset ledger.\n- Manual correction retains prior recognition watermarks. Manual intervention\n  still marks the shoe uncertain; this does not solve every occlusion/correction case.\n- New-shoe confirmation exits burn mode and cancels a pending duplicate reset.\n- Background comparison preserves connected white card faces over table markings;\n  morphology is applied with references and clothing above the dealer is excluded.\n- Foreshortening correction precedes deskewing; card tilt is subtracted.\n- The reader chooses one normal/inverted printed-corner orientation per seat and\n  holds that choice until a confirmed boundary. It does not deliberately feed\n  both orientations into tracking. This is not a physical-card identity model.\n- Logs contain actual hand angles, OCR confidence and chosen corner orientation.\n- Capture retains native display resolution instead of capping width at 1080px.\n\n## Remaining limitations\n\nThe last completed Android image replay still missed visible cards. The final\ncorner-selection change has unit coverage but no new end-to-end accuracy result.\nDo not assume that a moving count is correct. Angled/overlapping/hidden cards,\nsymmetric ranks, camera motion and blur can still cause omissions or duplicates.\nManual corrections, split reconstruction, visual shoe/cut-card recognition and\nexact automatic burn tracking are not fully solved. Hidden ranks are never guessed.\nMissing cards make the shoe count incomplete. The app uses limited strategy indices,\nnot an exact composition-dependent optimal strategy solver.\n\n## Build\n\nUse JDK 17, Android SDK 35 and Gradle 8.9 (wrapper included):\n\n    ./gradlew assembleDebug lintDebug\n    bash tests/run.sh\n\nAPK: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk\n\nAll application code, resources, build configuration, tests, Gradle wrapper and\ndevelopment signing files are included. Gradle downloads third-party dependencies;\nAndroid SDK/JDK and ML Kit source code are not bundled. The public development\nkeystore preserves update compatibility and is unsuitable for production signing.\n\nThe companion CompleteSource.txt is valid Python 3 containing the complete project\nas readable source strings and base64-encoded binary support files. To recreate\nit, save the entire file as restore.py and run python3 restore.py in an empty\nfolder. It refuses to overwrite existing files and verifies every file hash.\nDo not paste the bundle into a single Java file.\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'docs/VALIDATION-v0.9-historical.md': "# v0.9 validation status — October 3, 2026\n\nAutomatic card-recognition acceptance is NOT passed. This package completes the\ncode/build delivery, not the user's goal of a proven accurate automatic counter.\n\n## Evidence from the completed September 29 investigation\n\nBlackdiag08.jsonl contained 225 samples, zero observed cards and zero recognized\nrounds. Only three samples had a stable rank, at most one; none had a stable dealer\nrank. Confirmed cards were gated behind full-round recognition in v0.8.\n\nThe actual bundled ML Kit engine was tested in an Android API 30 software emulator\non six samples from blackjacv08n.mp4. Input was 720x1560 after removing its 180px\nrecorder footer. The 45-second sample was the empty reference, and the last logged\ntable/anchor coordinates were used. Actual historical hand angles were unavailable\nbecause v0.8 logged the legacy angle array rather than the one used by its reader.\n\nThe first replay exposed an incorrect deskew direction. The second replay after\nthat fix still failed. At the 15-second extraction slot it recovered a 4 while\nmissing the 10 in the same hand and the other seat's ranks. At the 80-second slot,\nreadable A and K tokens were rejected as inverted. This motivated the final\nconsistent-corner selector. That selector is implemented and unit-tested in the\ncurrent build, but a new full Android image replay has not validated it.\n\nEach replay image was processed once with a reset tracker. Its stable=0 result\nwas therefore expected and must not be quoted as an end-to-end count metric.\nThese were rank-candidate tests, not a complete temporal video or shoe benchmark.\nThe prior raw scratch outputs were removed by workspace maintenance; the source\nand documented changes were recovered for this delivery. No new accuracy figures\nare invented from those unavailable outputs.\n\n## Current checks\n\nThe pure-Java suite covers core counting, layout, scan start/stop, grouping,\nphysical-identity safeguards, table components, temporal tracking, round-state\nregressions and the new corner selector. It tests early confirmed counting,\nno recount at text/visual round starts, stale manual-correction reads, burn/shoe\ntransitions, white-face continuity, clothing exclusion, one orientation at a time,\nand orientation retention until a boundary. Results: docs/core-results.txt.\n\nBuild/signature results for the delivered binary are recorded in BUILD-RESULTS.txt.\nCompilation, lint and signing are not recognition-accuracy tests. Samsung capture,\noverlay runtime, native-resolution performance, long-run count accuracy and thermal\nbehavior are not newly validated in this delivery.\n\n## Remaining engineering work\n\nA validated physical-card/corner detector and rank classifier is still needed,\nwith labelled native-resolution images covering every rank, all seats, overlaps,\nrepeated cards, hits, split hands and clean boundaries. Corner orientation alone\ncannot prove that two recognized glyphs represent two different physical cards.\nThe movement safeguard can also withhold new hits when an earlier corner disappears.\nManual correction watermarks can withhold later cards in ambiguous combinations;\nmanual intervention remains explicitly marked as uncertain.\n\nCut-card classification, exact burns and automatic visual shoe replacement are\nnot solved. Preserve the manual review controls and do not infer hidden ranks.\n".encode("utf-8"),

    'docs/validation-v0.6.md': '# v0.6 validation\n\nRegression tests: confirmed cards can count despite an unrelated group warning; the prior negative-group gate reproduces the round-zero failure; empty tables request identity reset before any detected round; no cards or rounds are invented by that reset.\n\nReplay of all 344 sample events from Blackjack-diagnostics.jsonl (2), using recorded visible ranks, group counts and timestamps, produces one round start instead of zero and 24 empty-table confirmations. These repeated confirmations occur during long empty stretches; they are not a count of completed rounds. The replay does not rerun image recognition or validate the physical-card count.\n\nExisting tests pass: 31 core checks, 238 layout assertions, 25 scanner/filter checks, 13 grouping/round checks and 7 identity checks.\n\nAndroid build/signature status and APK hash are appended during release packaging. No Android device or emulator runtime test was performed. Missing card reads in the phone diagnostics remain a recognition limitation; this release addresses the global round-start block and stale identity reset.\n\nRelease: Android assembleDebug and lintDebug passed; zero lint errors. APK v2 signature verified; versionCode 6 / versionName 0.6-round-fix verified.\n\nAPK SHA256: 3e518c36ad4cbe3e015b15c807e3d620a9ebd48a9cc8019f0fea973ff3c958f8\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'docs/validation-v0.7.md': "# v0.7 validation — 2026-09-23\n\n## Scope of this release\n\nThe Android pipeline now scans one physical-table ROI rather than seven overlapping\nseat ROIs and a duplicate digital dealer ROI. Movable point anchors assign dealer\nand seat identities. Component crops are deskewed, OCR candidates are tracked\nin global coordinates, and selected-seat/group advice is separate from shoe counting.\nExisting green/red Start/Stop controls remain.\n\n## Automated checks\n\nRun `sh tests/run.sh` with JDK 17. Completed successfully:\n\n- 31 core count/strategy checks.\n- 238 legacy card-layout assertions.\n- 25 scanner lifecycle/orientation-filter checks.\n- 13 legacy grouping/round checks.\n- 7 legacy identity checks.\n- Round-start and pre-round identity-clear regressions.\n- 13 new global table-tracker checks: identical ranks, empty-seat numbering,\n  repeated observations, new hits, separated groups, occlusion, large movement,\n  ownership conflicts, duplicate observations, rank conflicts, reset boundaries,\n  consecutive confirmation, and advice gating during normal confirmation delay.\n- 6 new synthetic table-component checks: physical dealer plus fixed seat\n  ownership, exclusion outside the table ROI, removal of thin lettering,\n  merged-seat rejection, ambiguous nearest-anchor rejection, and unresolved-face protection against false clears.\n\nThese tests validate bookkeeping and synthetic geometry. They do not validate\nML Kit recognition of actual playing-card ranks or the correctness of a shoe count.\n\n## Android build\n\n`assembleDebug lintDebug` completed successfully with Gradle 8.9, JDK 17 and\nAndroid SDK 35. The final incremental build recompiled the changed sources.\nLint reported 0 errors and 15 warnings (existing accessibility, text/localization,\nRTL, view-constructor and data-extraction-rule issues).\n\nThe included Gradle wrapper was generated successfully and pins the distribution\nSHA-256. Its initial network bootstrap was blocked by this environment's proxy;\nthe build used the downloaded Gradle 8.9 distribution directly. No environment\nproxy settings or SDK paths are included in the project.\n\n## Unverified behavior and remaining risks\n\nNo Samsung install, live table, or on-device ML Kit video-replay accuracy test has\nbeen performed on v0.7. A debug build compiling is not evidence of detection accuracy.\nThe previously evaluated off-the-shelf YOLO models are not used in this release.\nNo custom model was trained.\n\nThe detector still uses light-face components and OCR, not a physical-card instance\nsegmentation model. A confirmed rank may still be wrong; opposite corners can\nstill be misinterpreted; unreadable cards can be missed without a warning.\nNearest-anchor grouping may misassign cards when dealing spreads into a neighbour's\nspace. Large movements are held for review rather than guessed as new cards.\n\nSeparated groups at one seat are selectable but automatic split reconstruction is\nnot reliable. The displayed hand must be checked, especially when groups merge or\ndisappear. A touching split pair can be interpreted as one hand. Dealer advice needs\nthe upcard to have been observed alone; joining after its reveal may leave WAIT.\n\nOld calibration is invalidated; anchors and table crop must be checked before\nStart. Test frame shows candidates without three-frame confirmation. It never\nchanges the running count. Recording is still downscaled by the legacy recorder;\nthat limits remote evaluation of tiny ranks.\n\nCut-card appearance is not an automatic reset signal. The new table pipeline does\nnot call the former barcode-texture heuristic. Shoe/burn confirmation is manual or\nuses the existing game-status text logic; hidden burned ranks cannot be recovered.\nThe old fixed-position seat-total OCR cross-check is not used by the table pipeline;\nthere is no independent total check in this release.\nThe strategy implementation remains the existing basic strategy and limited count\nindices, with its existing rule assumptions.\n\n## Suggested phone acceptance test\n\nAfter building, install the debug APK, recalibrate, and observe without wagering.\nRecord a complete deal-to-clear sequence, including an empty seat and at least one\nhit. Compare every physical exposed card with the `tracks`, `confirmed`, `hands`\nand count entries in exported diagnostics. Verify the dealer's digital duplicate\nis excluded, repeated frames do not add cards, seat changes do not change RC, Stop\nhalts updates, and separated hands are not concatenated in the displayed advice.\nAny missed/extra card fails counting validation and requires further detector work.\n".encode("utf-8"),

    'gradlew': '#!/bin/sh\n\n#\n# Copyright © 2015-2021 the original authors.\n#\n# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");\n# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.\n# You may obtain a copy of the License at\n#\n#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0\n#\n# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software\n# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,\n# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.\n# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and\n# limitations under the License.\n#\n# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n#\n\n##############################################################################\n#\n#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.\n#\n#   Important for running:\n#\n#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is\n#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or\n#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole\n#       command line, like:\n#\n#           ksh Gradle\n#\n#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script\n#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:\n#         * functions;\n#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,\n#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;\n#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;\n#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».\n#\n#   Important for patching:\n#\n#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided\n#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.\n#\n#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a\n#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security\n#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating\n#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.\n#\n#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,\n#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;\n#       see the in-line comments for details.\n#\n#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,\n#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.\n#\n#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template\n#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt\n#       within the Gradle project.\n#\n#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.\n#\n##############################################################################\n\n# Attempt to set APP_HOME\n\n# Resolve links: $0 may be a link\napp_path=$0\n\n# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.\nwhile\n    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path\n    [ -h "$app_path" ]\ndo\n    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )\n    link=${ls#*\' -> \'}\n    case $link in             #(\n      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(\n      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;\n    esac\ndone\n\n# This is normally unused\n# shellcheck disable=SC2034\nAPP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}\n# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)\nAPP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf \'%s\n\' "$PWD" ) || exit\n\n# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.\nMAX_FD=maximum\n\nwarn () {\n    echo "$*"\n} >&2\n\ndie () {\n    echo\n    echo "$*"\n    echo\n    exit 1\n} >&2\n\n# OS specific support (must be \'true\' or \'false\').\ncygwin=false\nmsys=false\ndarwin=false\nnonstop=false\ncase "$( uname )" in                #(\n  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(\n  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(\n  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(\n  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;\nesac\n\nCLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar\n\n\n# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.\nif [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then\n    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then\n        # IBM\'s JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables\n        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java\n    else\n        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java\n    fi\n    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then\n        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME\n\nPlease set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the\nlocation of your Java installation."\n    fi\nelse\n    JAVACMD=java\n    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1\n    then\n        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no \'java\' command could be found in your PATH.\n\nPlease set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the\nlocation of your Java installation."\n    fi\nfi\n\n# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.\nif ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then\n    case $MAX_FD in #(\n      max*)\n        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That\'s why the result is checked to see if it worked.\n        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045\n        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||\n            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"\n    esac\n    case $MAX_FD in  #(\n      \'\' | soft) :;; #(\n      *)\n        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That\'s why the result is checked to see if it worked.\n        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045\n        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||\n            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"\n    esac\nfi\n\n# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:\n#   * args from the command line\n#   * the main class name\n#   * -classpath\n#   * -D...appname settings\n#   * --module-path (only if needed)\n#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.\n\n# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java\nif "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then\n    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )\n    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )\n\n    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )\n\n    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh\n    for arg do\n        if\n            case $arg in                                #(\n              -*)   false ;;                            # don\'t mess with options #(\n              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath\n                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(\n              *)    false ;;\n            esac\n        then\n            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )\n        fi\n        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of\n        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but\n        # possibly modified.\n        #\n        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so\n        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of\n        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.\n        shift                   # remove old arg\n        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg\n    done\nfi\n\n\n# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.\nDEFAULT_JVM_OPTS=\'"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"\'\n\n# Collect all arguments for the java command:\n#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,\n#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.\n#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be\n#     treated as \'${Hostname}\' itself on the command line.\n\nset -- \\\n        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \\\n        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \\\n        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \\\n        "$@"\n\n# Stop when "xargs" is not available.\nif ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1\nthen\n    die "xargs is not available"\nfi\n\n# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.\n#\n# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.\n#\n# In Bash we could simply go:\n#\n#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&\n#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"\n#\n# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we\n# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any\n# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse\n# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap\n# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.\n#\n# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or\n# an unmatched quote.\n#\n\neval "set -- $(\n        printf \'%s\\n\' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |\n        xargs -n1 |\n        sed \' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\\\&~g; \' |\n        tr \'\\n\' \' \'\n    )" \'"$@"\'\n\nexec "$JAVACMD" "$@"\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'gradlew.bat': '@rem\r\n@rem Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.\r\n@rem\r\n@rem Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");\r\n@rem you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.\r\n@rem You may obtain a copy of the License at\r\n@rem\r\n@rem      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0\r\n@rem\r\n@rem Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software\r\n@rem distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,\r\n@rem WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.\r\n@rem See the License for the specific language governing permissions and\r\n@rem limitations under the License.\r\n@rem\r\n@rem SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\r\n@rem\r\n\r\n@if "%DEBUG%"=="" @echo off\r\n@rem ##########################################################################\r\n@rem\r\n@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows\r\n@rem\r\n@rem ##########################################################################\r\n\r\n@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell\r\nif "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal\r\n\r\nset DIRNAME=%~dp0\r\nif "%DIRNAME%"=="" set DIRNAME=.\r\n@rem This is normally unused\r\nset APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0\r\nset APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%\r\n\r\n@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.\r\nfor %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi\r\n\r\n@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.\r\nset DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"\r\n\r\n@rem Find java.exe\r\nif defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome\r\n\r\nset JAVA_EXE=java.exe\r\n%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1\r\nif %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto execute\r\n\r\necho. 1>&2\r\necho ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no \'java\' command could be found in your PATH. 1>&2\r\necho. 1>&2\r\necho Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2\r\necho location of your Java installation. 1>&2\r\n\r\ngoto fail\r\n\r\n:findJavaFromJavaHome\r\nset JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%\r\nset JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe\r\n\r\nif exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute\r\n\r\necho. 1>&2\r\necho ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME% 1>&2\r\necho. 1>&2\r\necho Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2\r\necho location of your Java installation. 1>&2\r\n\r\ngoto fail\r\n\r\n:execute\r\n@rem Setup the command line\r\n\r\nset CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\\gradle\\wrapper\\gradle-wrapper.jar\r\n\r\n\r\n@rem Execute Gradle\r\n"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain %*\r\n\r\n:end\r\n@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell\r\nif %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto mainEnd\r\n\r\n:fail\r\nrem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of\r\nrem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!\r\nset EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%\r\nif %EXIT_CODE% equ 0 set EXIT_CODE=1\r\nif not ""=="%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit %EXIT_CODE%\r\nexit /b %EXIT_CODE%\r\n\r\n:mainEnd\r\nif "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal\r\n\r\n:omega\r\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'settings.gradle': "pluginManagement { repositories { google(); mavenCentral(); gradlePluginPortal() } }\ndependencyResolutionManagement { repositoriesMode.set(RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS); repositories { google(); mavenCentral() } }\nrootProject.name = 'BlackjackOverlay'\ninclude ':app'\n".encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/CardLayoutTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.CardLayout;\npublic class CardLayoutTest {\n    static int n;static void check(boolean b){n++;if(!b)throw new AssertionError("Layout check "+n);}\n    static boolean near(float a,float b){return Math.abs(a-b)<.00001f;}\n    public static void main(String[] args){\n        CardLayout c=new CardLayout();\n        for(int h=0;h<7;h++)for(int k=0;k<5;k++){float[] q=c.corners(h,k,945,2048);check(q.length==8);for(int i=0;i<8;i+=2)check(q[i]>=0&&q[i]<945&&q[i+1]>=0&&q[i+1]<2048);if(k>0)check(c.slots[h][k][1]<c.slots[h][k-1][1]);}\n        for(int h=1;h<7;h++)check(c.slots[h][0][0]>c.slots[h-1][0][0]);\n        CardLayout old=c.copy();c.slots[0][0][0]+=.01f;check(near(old.slots[0][0][0],171/945f));check(near(c.slots[1][0][0],old.slots[1][0][0]));\n        c=old.copy();float[] b=c.bounds(3);c.transformHand(3,b[0]+.02f,b[1]+.01f,b[2]+.02f,b[3]+.01f);\n        for(int k=0;k<5;k++){check(near(c.slots[3][k][0],old.slots[3][k][0]+.02f));check(near(c.slots[3][k][1],old.slots[3][k][1]+.01f));check(near(c.slots[3][k][2],old.slots[3][k][2]));}\n        c=old.copy();c.rotate(2,1,5,945f/2048);check(near(c.slots[2][1][4],old.slots[2][1][4]+5));check(near(c.slots[2][0][4],old.slots[2][0][4]));\n        c=old.copy();c.rotate(4,-1,15,945f/2048);c.rotate(4,-1,-15,945f/2048);for(int k=0;k<5;k++){check(near(c.slots[4][k][0],old.slots[4][k][0]));check(near(c.slots[4][k][1],old.slots[4][k][1]));}\n        System.out.println("PASS: "+n+" layout assertions");\n    }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/CoreTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;\nimport java.util.*;\npublic class CoreTest {\n static int checks=0;static void check(boolean v,String msg){checks++;if(!v)throw new AssertionError(msg);}\n static List<String> c(String...s){return Arrays.asList(s);}\n static void observe(TableState t,int seat,String...s){for(int i=0;i<3;i++)t.observe(seat,c(s));}\n public static void main(String[]args){\n  check(CountEngine.parseRank("Q♠").equals("Q"),"suit stripped");check(CountEngine.parseRank("20")==null,"total rejected");\n  check(Strategy.total(c("A","A","9"))==21,"multiple aces");check(Strategy.soft(c("A","6")),"soft17");check(!Strategy.soft(c("A","6","K")),"hard17");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("8","8"),"K",0,false,false).action.equals("SPLIT"),"8s split");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("8","8"),"K",2,true,false).fallback.equals("STAND"),"pair fallback uses index");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("A","7"),"4",0,false,false).fallback.equals("STAND"),"soft18 double fallback");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("A","7"),"4",0,false,false).action.equals("DOUBLE"),"soft18 double");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("10","6"),"10",-.1,true,false).action.equals("HIT"),"16 below0");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("10","6"),"10",0,true,false).action.equals("STAND"),"16 boundary0");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("10","5"),"10",3.99,true,false).action.equals("HIT"),"15 below4");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("10","5"),"10",4,true,false).action.equals("STAND"),"15 boundary4");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("7","5"),"5",-3,true,false).action.equals("HIT"),"negative count reversal");\n  check(Strategy.advise(c("2","3","6"),"6",9,true,false).action.equals("HIT"),"no 3-card observe(t,1,"8","8");check(t.observed==2,"two identical cards preserved");observe(t,1,"8","8");check(t.observed==2,"no repeated-frame duplicates");\n  observe(t,1);observe(t,1,"8","8");check(t.observed==2,"occlusion no recount");\n  observe(t,1,"8","8","2");check(t.observed==3&&t.running==1,"new dealt rank");\n  observe(t,2,"2","A");check(t.observed==5&&t.running==1,"separate seats");\n  for(int i=0;i<3;i++)t.status("Play behind other participants");for(int i=0;i<3;i++)t.status("Round in     'tests/CornerSelectorTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;\npublic class CornerSelectorTest {\n static void check(boolean b,String msg){if(!b)throw new AssertionError(msg);}\n public static void main(String[] args){\n  CornerSelector c=new CornerSelector();check(c.choose(1,0,0)==0,"no evidence cannot select a mode");\n  check(c.choose(1,0,2)==-1,"inverted readable corners accepted");\n  check(c.choose(1,3,1)==-1,"cannot switch corner ends during a hand");\n  check(c.choose(2,2,2)==1,"a tie selects only one end");\n  c.clear();check(c.choose(1,2,0)==1,"confirmed boundary releases orientation");\n  check(RankFilter.orientation(175)==-1&&RankFilter.orientation(-180)==-1,"inverted classification");\n  check(RankFilter.orientation(90)==0&&RankFilter.orientation(Float.NaN)==0,"sideways and invalid rejected");\n  System.out.println("PASS: 7 corner-orientation regressions");\n }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/GroupingTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;\nimport java.util.*;\npublic class GroupingTest {\n static int checks;static void check(boolean v,String m){checks++;if(!v)throw new AssertionError(m);}\n static float[] box(float l,float t,float r,float b){return new float[]{l,t,r,t,r,b,l,b};}\n static float[][] boxes(){float[][] q=new float[8][];q[0]=box(0,0,100,50);for(int i=1;i<8;i++)q[i]=box(1000+i*100,1000,1090+i*100,1090);q[1]=box(30,60,180,190);q[2]=box(115,60,270,190);return q;}\n static void rect(int[] pixels,int w,int l,int t,int r,int b){for(int y=t;y<b;y++)for(int x=l;x<r;x++)pixels[y*w+x]=0xffffffff;}\n static List<List<String>> empty(){List<List<String>> v=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<8;i++)v.add(new ArrayList<>());return v;}\n public static void main(String[] args){\n  int w=540,h=240;int[] p=new int[w*h];rect(p,w,85,110,126,146);rect(p,w,113,96,154,132);rect(p,w,190,105,220,150);\n  HandGrouping g=new HandGrouping(p,w,h,boxes());check(g.groups.size()==2,"touching cards make one cluster; nearby separate hand stays separate");\n  List<HandGrouping.Read> reads=Arrays.asList(new HandGrouping.Read("8",120,115,1),new HandGrouping.Read("8",120.5f,115,2),new HandGrouping.Read("8",93,136,1),new HandGrouping.Read("5",200,120,2));\n  List<List<String>> r=g.assign(reads);check(r.get(1).equals(Arrays.asList("8","8")),"overlapping boxes deduplicated; distinct identical cards kept");check(r.get(2).equals(Arrays.asList("5")),"neighbor stays in own hand");check(g.duplicates==1,"duplicate diagnostic");\n  HandGrouping conflict=new HandGrouping(p,w,h,boxes());r=conflict.assign(Arrays.asList(new HandGrouping.Read("8",120,115,1),new HandGrouping.Read("3",120,115,2)));check(r.get(1).isEmpty()&&conflict.ambiguous==1,"conflicting rank at same corner withheld");\n  HandGrouping.Ownership locks=new HandGrouping.Ownership();locks.apply(g);float[][] shifted=boxes();shifted[1]=box(0,60,160,190);shifted[2]=box(100,60,200,190);HandGrouping moved=new HandGrouping(p,w,h,shifted);locks.apply(moved);r=moved.assign(reads);check(r.get(1).size()==2,"cluster ownership retained despite changed closest box");\n  TableState state=new TableState();List<List<String>> ranks=empty();ranks.get(0).add("K");ranks.get(1).addAll(Arrays.asList("8","8"));\n  for(int i=0;i<3;i++)state.scene("SEAT CALIBRATE",ranks,1,i*1000);check(state.inRound&&state.round==1,"two-card hand plus dealer starts round with hidden status");\n  for(int i=0;i<3;i++)state.observe(1,ranks.get(1));check(state.observed==2,"initial pair counted");\n  for(int i=0;i<5;i++){state.scene("Please take a seat",ranks,1,4000+i*1000);state.observe(1,ranks.get(1));}check(state.round==1&&state.observed==2,"observer idle label cannot reset visible hand");\n  for(int i=0;i<6;i++)state.scene("",empty(),1,10000+i*1000);check(state.inRound,"OCR dropout with card faces cannot clear hand");\n  state.scene("",empty(),0,18000);state.scene("",empty(),0,19000);state.scene("",ranks,1,20000);check(state.inRound,"brief obstruction cannot reset");\n  for(int i=0;i<4;i++)state.scene("",empty(),0,21000+i*1000);check(!state.inRound&&state.observed==2,"confirmed empty table ends hand but retains shoe count");\n  for(int i=0;i<3;i++)state.scene("",ranks,1,26000+i*1000);for(int i=0;i<3;i++)state.observe(1,ranks.get(1));check(state.round==2&&state.observed==4,"same pair next round counted once again");\n  System.out.println("PASS: "+checks+" grouping/round checks");\n }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/IdentityTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;import java.util.*;\npublic class IdentityTest {\n static int n;static void check(boolean b,String m){n++;if(!b)throw new AssertionError(m);}\n static HandGrouping.Read r(String rank,float x,int seat){return new HandGrouping.Read(rank,x,120,seat);}\n public static void main(String[] args){\n  CardIdentity tracker=new CardIdentity();List<List<String>> out=null;\n  for(int i=0;i<3;i++)out=tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("8",100,1),r("8",120,1)),540);\n  check(out.get(1).size()==2,"identical physical cards distinct");\n  for(int i=0;i<5;i++)out=tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("8",101,1),r("8",121,1)),540);\n  check(out.get(1).size()==2,"jitter and repeats not extra cards");\n  for(int i=0;i<3;i++)out=tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("8",121,1),r("8",145,1)),540);\n  check(out.get(1).size()==3,"new identical card counts while old card occluded");\n  out=tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("3",101,1)),540);check(tracker.conflict&&out.get(1).size()==3,"changed OCR rank cannot create extra card");\n  for(int i=0;i<4;i++)out=tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("8",101,2)),540);\n  check(out.get(1).size()==3&&out.get(2).isEmpty(),"same physical corner reassigned by overlapping box not recounted");\n  tracker.clear();for(int i=0;i<3;i++)out=tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("8",100,2)),540);check(out.get(2).size()==1,"new round resets identities");\n  tracker.clear();tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("K",100,1)),540);tracker.observe(Collections.emptyList(),540);out=tracker.observe(Arrays.asList(r("K",100,1)),540);check(out.get(1).isEmpty(),"intermittent one-frame read not confirmed");\n  System.out.println("PASS: "+n+" identity checks");\n }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/ReplayComponents.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;\nimport javax.imageio.ImageIO;import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;import java.awt.*;import java.io.*;\npublic class ReplayComponents{\n static int W=720,H=1560;\n static int[] pixels(String p)throws Exception{BufferedImage b=ImageIO.read(new File(p)),r=new BufferedImage(W,H,BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);Graphics2D g=r.createGraphics();g.drawImage(b,0,0,W,H,0,0,b.getWidth(),b.getHeight()-140,null);g.dispose();return r.getRGB(0,0,W,H,null,0,W);}\n public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{\n float[] roi={.0032199f*W,.24678445f*H,.97121996f*W,.24678445f*H,.97121996f*W,.3729233f*H,.0032199f*W,.3729233f*H};\n float[][] anchors={{.5241048f,.2687695f},{.20645034f,.31939247f},{.3220933f,.33256534f},{.42114142f,.3334239f},{.5322827f,.33976948f},{.6364189f,.32873285f},{.7352461f,.32552865f},{.83931947f,.30576953f}};\n for(float[] a:anchors){a[0]*=W;a[1]*=H;}\n int[] ref=args[0].equals("none")?null:pixels(args[0]);\n for(int i=1;i<args.length;i++){int[] p=pixels(args[i]);TableComponents c=new TableComponents(p,W,H,roi,anchors,ref);System.out.println(args[i]+" groups="+c.groups.size()+" ambiguous="+c.ambiguous+" unresolved="+c.unresolvedFaces+" small="+c.rejectedSmall+" "+c.groups);\n BufferedImage b=new BufferedImage(W,H,BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);b.setRGB(0,0,W,H,p,0,W);Graphics2D g=b.createGraphics();g.setColor(Color.GREEN);for(TableComponents.Group v:c.groups){g.drawRect(v.left,v.top,v.right-v.left,v.bottom-v.top);g.drawString(""+v.owner,v.left,v.top-3);}g.dispose();ImageIO.write(b,"png",new File(args[i]+".boxes.png"));}\n }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/ReplayGeometry.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;import javax.imageio.ImageIO;import java.io.*;import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;\npublic class ReplayGeometry {\n public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{\n BufferedImage image=ImageIO.read(new File(args[0]));int w=image.getWidth(),h=1140;int[] pixels=image.getRGB(0,0,w,h,null,0,w);\n float[][] b={{.0017356f,.1848148f,.3319727f,.2093148f},{.1500043f,.3200364f,.2588045f,.4131179f},{.2832903f,.3465987f,.3785354f,.4445406f},{.382133f,.360193f,.469691f,.447411f},{.4670005f,.3668528f,.5806391f,.4560285f},{.5657399f,.3583123f,.6766145f,.4455253f},{.6759166f,.3496098f,.7873304f,.4469464f},{.770035f,.332764f,.892379f,.422277f}};\n float[] angles={0,325,333,348,355,0,7,34};float[][] q=new float[8][];\n for(int i=0;i<8;i++){float cx=(b[i][0]+b[i][2])*w/2,cy=(b[i][1]+b[i][3])*h/2,hw=(b[i][2]-b[i][0])*w/2,hh=(b[i][3]-b[i][1])*h/2;float[] a={-hw,-hh,hw,-hh,hw,hh,-hw,hh};double theta=Math.toRadians(-angles[i]);for(int j=0;j<8;j+=2){float x=a[j],y=a[j+1];a[j]=cx+(float)(x*Math.cos(theta)-y*Math.sin(theta));a[j+1]=cy+(float)(x*Math.sin(theta)+y*Math.cos(theta));}q[i]=a;}\n HandGrouping g=new HandGrouping(pixels,w,h,q);\n java.util.List<HandGrouping.Read> reads=new java.util.ArrayList<>();float[][] anchors={{92,441},{164,461},{222,466},{276,467},{330,466},{397,455},{439,430}};\n for(int i=0;i<7;i++)reads.add(new HandGrouping.Read("8",anchors[i][0],anchors[i][1],i+1));\n g.assign(reads);new HandGrouping.Ownership().apply(g);java.util.List<java.util.List<String>> hands=g.assign(reads);\n for(int i=1;i<=7;i++)if(hands.get(i).size()!=1)throw new AssertionError("Wrong seat "+i+": "+hands);\n System.out.println("PASS: seven annotated hand positions assigned correctly; unlabelled bright shoe object excluded. This checks geometry, not OCR.");\n }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),

hands(){List<List<String>> h=empty();h.get(0).add("A");h.get(2).addAll(Arrays.asList("A","8"));return h;}\n public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{\n  TableState early=new progress",hands(),3,1000*i);early.observeConfirmed(3,Arrays.asList("K"));check(early.observed==1,"round start does not recount early card");\n  TableState visual=new round start retains ledger");\n  TableState manual=new shoe=new TableState();for(int i=0;i<3;i++)shoe.status("burn procedure");shoe.startShoe();shoe.observeConfirmed(1,Arrays.asList("2"));check(shoe.observed==1&&!shoe.burning,"manual shoe exits burn phase");for(int i=0;i<3;i++)shoe.status("place your bets");check(shoe.shoe==1,"manual shoe not reset twice");\n  TableState t=new TableState();for(int i=0;i<3;i++){t.flag("Ambiguous detections skipped");t.scene("",hands(),3,1000*i);}\n  check(t.inRound&&t.round==1,"valid hand starts despite unrelated warning");t.observeConfirmed(2,Arrays.asList("A","8"));check(t.observed==2,"confirmed cards counted");\n  TableState waiting=new TableState();boolean reset=false;for(int i=0;i<4;i++)reset=waiting.scene("",empty(),0,1000*i);check(reset,"empty table resets identities before first detected i=0;i<5;i++)oldGate.scene("",hands(),-1,1000*i);check(!oldGate.inRound,"reproduced old global-warning deadlock");\n  if(args.length>0){TableState replay=new TableState();int clears=0;for(String line:Files.readAllLines(Paths.get(args[0]))){\n   String[] fields=line.split("\\\\t",-1);int groups=Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);List<List<String>> cards=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=2;i<10;i++)cards.add(fields[i].isEmpty()?new ArrayList<>():new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(fields[i].split(","))));\n   if(replay.scene("",cards,groups,Long.parseLong(fields[0])))clears++;\n  }check(replay.round>0,"uploaded diagnostics no longer stuck on round zero");System.out.println("Uploaded rank-stream replay: "+replay.round+" round starts; "+clears+" empty-table confirmations.     'tests/ScannerTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.ScanControl;\nimport com.example.blackjackoverlay.RankFilter;\npublic class ScannerTest {\n    static int n;static void check(boolean b){n++;if(!b)throw new AssertionError("Scanner check "+n);}\n    public static void main(String[] args){\n        ScanControl s=new ScanControl();check(!s.running());check(!s.accept(s.token()));int first=s.start();check(s.running());check(s.accept(first));s.stop();check(!s.running());check(!s.accept(first));int second=s.start();check(s.accept(second));check(!s.accept(first));s.stop();s.stop();check(!s.running());check(!s.accept(second));\n        for(float a:new float[]{0,5,-5,25,-25,55,-55})check(RankFilter.upright(a));\n        for(float a:new float[]{56,-56,90,-90,180,-180,Float.NaN,Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY})check(!RankFilter.upright(a));\n        System.out.println("PASS: "+n+" scanner/filter checks");\n    }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/TableComponentsTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;import java.util.*;\npublic class TableComponentsTest {\n static int n;static void check(boolean b,String m){n++;if(!b)throw new AssertionError(m);}\n static final int W=540,H=360;static final float[] ROI={0,40,540,40,540,300,0,300};\n static final float[][] A={{270,80},{50,240},{125,240},{200,240},{275,240},{350,240},{425,240},{500,240}};\n static void rect(int[] p,int l,int t,int r,int b){for(int y=t;y<b;y++)for(int x=l;x<r;x++)p[y*W+x]=0xffffffff;}\n public static void main(String[] args){\n  int[] p=new int[W*H];rect(p,255,60,285,100);rect(p,110,220,140,260);rect(p,410,220,440,260);\n  TableComponents c=new TableComponents(p,W,H,ROI,A);Set<Integer> owners=new HashSet<>();for(TableComponents.Group g:c.groups)owners.add(g.owner);\n  check(owners.equals(new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(0,2,6))),"physical dealer and fixed seat anchors from one ROI");\n  rect(p,100,10,140,30);c=new TableComponents(p,W,H,ROI,A);check(c.groups.size()==3,"digital cards outside table excluded");\n  rect(p,20,150,510,151);c=new TableComponents(p,W,H,ROI,A);check(c.groups.size()==3,"thin table lettering removed");\n  p=new int[W*H];rect(p,100,220,220,260);c=new TableComponents(p,W,H,ROI,A);check(c.groups.isEmpty()&&c.ambiguous>0,"merged face across two seat anchors withheld");\n  p=new int[W*H];rect(p,72,220,103,260);c=new TableComponents(p,W,H,ROI,A);check(c.groups.isEmpty()&&c.ambiguous>0,"equidistant seat ownership withheld");\n  p=new int[W*H];rect(p,119,230,131,242);c=new TableComponents(p,W,H,ROI,A);check(c.groups.isEmpty()&&c.unresolvedFaces,"small unresolved face cannot establish an empty table");\n  int[] empty=new int[W*H];rect(empty,240,150,290,158); // stationary felt lettering\n  c=new TableComponents(empty,W,H,ROI,A,empty.clone());check(c.groups.isEmpty()&&!c.unresolvedFaces,"reference removes unchanged markings");\n  int[] dealt=empty.clone();rect(dealt,258,75,282,84); // small foreshortened dealer face\n  c=new TableComponents(dealt,W,H,ROI,A,empty);check(c.groups.size()==1&&c.groups.get(0).owner==0,"small dealer face survives reference pipeline");\n  c=new TableComponents(empty,W,H,ROI,A,empty);check(c.groups.isEmpty(),"dealer disappearance permits clean-table evidence");\n  boolean rejected=false;try{new TableComponents(empty,W,H,ROI,A,new int[1]);}catch(IllegalArgumentException e){rejected=true;}check(rejected,"mismatched reference dimensions rejected");\n  int[] tiny=empty.clone();rect(tiny,119,230,126,238);c=new TableComponents(tiny,W,H,ROI,A,empty);check(c.unresolvedFaces,"unreadable small face still prevents false empty");\n  int[] partial=empty.clone();rect(partial,258,75,282,84);int[] patterned=empty.clone();rect(patterned,265,75,273,84);\n  c=new TableComponents(partial,W,H,ROI,A,patterned);check(c.groups.size()==1&&c.groups.get(0).right-c.groups.get(0).left>=22,"unchanged white pixels do not fragment new card");\n  int[] sleeve=empty.clone();rect(sleeve,258,42,282,50);c=new TableComponents(sleeve,W,H,ROI,A,empty);check(c.groups.isEmpty(),"clothing above dealer anchor excluded");\n  System.out.println("PASS: "+n+" table region checks");\n }\n}\n'.encode("utf-8"),
    'tests/TableTrackerTest.java': 'import com.example.blackjackoverlay.*;import java.util.*;\npublic class TableTrackerTest {\n static int n;static void check(boolean b,String message){n++;if(!b)throw new AssertionError(message);}\n static TableTracker.Detection d(String r,float x,int seat,int group){return new TableTracker.Detection(r,x,100,seat,group);}\n static TableTracker.Result repeat(TableTracker t,TableTracker.Detection... reads){TableTracker.Result r=null;for(int i=0;i<3;i++)r=t.observe(Arrays.asList(reads),1000);return r;}\n public static void main(String[] args){\n  TableTracker t=new TableTracker();TableTracker.Result r=repeat(t,d("8",100,1,1),d("8",140,1,1),d("A",500,4,4));\n  check(r.counted.get(1).size()==2,"two equal cards remain distinct");check(r.counted.get(4).size()==1,"empty seats do not renumber seat 4");\n  r=repeat(t,d("8",101,1,1),d("8",140,1,1),d("A",500,4,4));check(r.counted.get(1).size()==2,"jitter not recounted");\n  r=repeat(t,d("8",101,1,1),d("8",140,1,2),d("A",500,4,4),d("3",180,1,2));\n  check(r.counted.get(1).size()==3,"one new hit counted once");check(r.hands.get(2).size()==2,"split groups separated for advice");\n  r=repeat(t,d("8",101,1,1),d("3",180,1,2),d("A",500,4,4));check(r.counted.get(1).size()==3&&r.unsafeSeats.contains(1),"occlusion retains history, blocks seat advice");\n  r=repeat(t,d("8",101,1,1),d("8",250,1,2),d("3",180,1,2),d("A",500,4,4));check(r.counted.get(1).size()==3,"large movement held instead of duplicate count");\n  r=repeat(t,d("8",101,2,1),d("8",140,1,2),d("3",180,1,2),d("A",500,4,4));check(r.counted.get(2).isEmpty()&&r.unsafeSeats.contains(2),"seat boundary cannot recount card");\n  t.clear();r=repeat(t,d("K",100,1,1),d("K",102,1,1));check(r.counted.get(1).size()==1,"duplicate observations deduplicated globally");\n root = Path('BlackjackProject')
for name, data in FILES.items():
    target = root / name
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
        raise ValueError('Invalid bundle path')
    if target.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(str(target))
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != HASHES[name]:
        raise ValueError('Checksum mismatch: ' + name)
for name, data in FILES.items():
    target = root / name
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(data)
print('Restored BlackjackProject. See README.md for build steps and validation status.')
